title: Agency 2026 show agenda
description: The whole run of show as data: days, segments, the scenes each segment shows, slides, video, sound cues and operator notes. Read by show/control.html and show/stage.html. Times are local wall-clock times in event.timezone.

event.description: Event facts. Copy them from brand/tokens/tokens.json (event); do not invent others.

theme.description: compliant: the event team's template look (Arial / Liberation Sans). mvai: the MVAI kit (Inter). The operator can switch it live.

sample.description: true tags every content screen 'Sample content' (for demo agendas).

cueFiles.description: Cue lists (paths from the repo root), merged in order; later files win on the same id.

cues.description: Cues defined in the agenda itself (win over cueFiles).

pads.description: Cue ids on the control's sound pads 1-9.

voiceManifest.description: Voiced announcements from scripts/voice/say.py (default out/voice/manifest.json). Each clip becomes a cue the operator fires from the control's Announce box.

moderator.description: Panel moderator: introduced last with the panel-moderator formula and flagged on the panel card.

fact.description: At most one extra fact, supplied or approved by the person, as a predicate that completes '{name} {fact}.' (speaker-fact). Spoken only; never praise.

person.description: Names, roles and organisations come from the person, in writing (guides/NARRATION.md). On screen the lower third is the name on line 1 and 'role · organization' on line 2. Pronunciation goes in brand/voice/lexicon.json.

type.description: Sets the default scenes: holding->holding, welcome->opening, countdown->countdown, session/demo->title (+slides, +video), speaker-intro->intro (+slides, +video), panel->panel (+slides), break/lunch->break, video->video, slides->slides, thanks/sponsor->thanks, closing->closing, bumper->bumper, stat->stat.

notes.description: Operator notes, shown in the control only.

scenes.description: The screens this segment steps through. Omit to use the type's defaults. GO moves to the next scene, then the next segment.

what.description: demo: what the demo is, as a phrase that completes '{title} is {what}, built by {team}.' (brand/voice/intros.json demo-intro). From the demo team, in writing.

team.description: demo: the team that built it, full name ('the Example Branch'). Shown on the demo title card as 'Built by {team}'.

subject.description: video: what the video is about, completing '{title} is a video about {subject}.' (video-intro).

scene.description: Any segment field may be repeated here to override it for this scene.

speaker.description: intro: which speaker of the list (default 0)

lowerThird.description: Fire the lower third for speaker 0 (true) or speaker n, lowerDelay s after the scene starts, for lowerSeconds s

target.description: countdown: count to this time instead of the next segment's start

minutes.description: countdown: count this many minutes from when it goes on air (when no target and no next segment)

next.description: countdown: index of the segment it counts to

label.description: countdown: the line above the clock (default 'Next session begins in'); stat: the line under the number

value.description: stat: the number (label: the line under it; sub: the line under that)

slides.description: A list of image paths, {images: [...]}, or {dir, pattern, count, start}: pattern 'slide-{nn}.jpg' numbers from start (default 1). Render decks with scripts/make.mjs; convert a PDF with: pdftoppm -r 144 -jpeg deck.pdf dir/slide

video.description: An MP4 path, or {src, autoplay (default true), autoAdvance (default true: GO when it ends), loop, muted}. Sound plays through the show mixer and ducks the music bed.

music.description: Cue ids. bed: start this bed (null fades the bed out; leave it out to keep the current bed). sting and walkup fire once when the scene goes on air with GO or TAKE (not with BACK).

transition.description: Into this scene. Default: sweep between segments, fade within a segment.

cue.description: A sound cue. One file can give several cues with different in and out points.

kind.description: bed: loops under the show, one at a time. The rest play once, over the bed.

file.description: Path from the repo root (mp3, wav, m4a)

lufs.description: Measured integrated loudness of the file; the mixer adds (-16 - lufs) dB so every cue sits at one level
